title: Boss: the 2 a.m. config fix
summary: Model nano well enough to script a real edit session.

steps.title: The pager went off
steps.body: A service on a server will not start because of its config. You will model the nano session that fixes it: decode the shortcut bar, replay a session of keys, and run a replace-all.

steps.title: Decode a whole shortcut bar
prompt: nano's bottom bar is text like `^G Help  ^O Write Out  M-U Undo`. Write `List<string> DecodeBar(string bar)` that returns one entry per shortcut as `"<keys> = <label>"`, where keys use `Ctrl+`/`Alt+` (uppercase letter) and the label is the words after the shortcut up to the next shortcut, trimmed.
`DecodeBar("^G Help  ^O Write Out  M-U Undo")` returns `Ctrl+G = Help`, `Ctrl+O = Write Out`, `Alt+U = Undo`.
A shortcut is a whitespace-separated token that starts with `^` (length 2+) or `M-` (length 3+).
solution: void Flush() { if (keys != null) result.Add(keys + " = " + string.Join(" ", label)); label.Clear(); }
else if (token.StartsWith("M-") && token.Length >= 3) { Flush(); keys = "Alt+" + token.Substring(2).ToUpperInvariant(); }
hints: Split on spaces with `RemoveEmptyEntries` and walk the tokens.
When you meet a new shortcut, first emit the previous one with the words collected so far.
template: Dojo.Eq("three shortcuts", new List<string> { "Ctrl+G = Help", "Ctrl+O = Write Out", "Alt+U = Undo" }, DecodeBar("^G Help  ^O Write Out  M-U Undo"));
Dojo.Eq("go to line and replace", new List<string> { "Ctrl+_ = Go To Line", "Ctrl+\\ = Replace" }, DecodeBar("^_ Go To Line ^\\ Replace"));

steps.title: Replay a nano session
prompt: Write `List<string> Session(List<string> lines, string[] keys)` where the cursor starts on line 0 and keys are:
- `"Down"`, `"Up"` move one line (stay inside the file),
- `"Go:<n>"` jumps to line `n` (1-based, clamped to the file),

- `"K"` cut (consecutive `K`s accumulate, as in lesson 2), `"M-6"` copy the current line into the buffer (a fresh buffer unless the previous key was also `"M-6"`), `"U"` paste the buffer above the cursor line and move the cursor down past it,
Clamp the cursor after every change. Return the final lines.
solution: int Clamp(int c) => Math.Max(0, Math.Min(c, text.Count - 1));
else if (key == "U") { text.InsertRange(cursor, buffer); cursor = Clamp(cursor + buffer.Count); }
else if (key.StartsWith("Type:")) { if (text.Count == 0) text.Add(""); text[cursor] = key.Substring(5); }
hints: Write a `Clamp` local function and call it after every change.
In nano, M-6 also moves the cursor to the next line, like here.
template: Dojo.Eq("fix the port", new List<string> { "[server]", "port=8080", "host=0.0.0.0", "[log]", "level=debug" }, Session(dojoConf, new[] { "Down", "Type:port=8080" }));
Dojo.Eq("move the log section to the top", new List<string> { "[log]", "level=debug", "[server]", "port=80", "host=0.0.0.0" }, Session(dojoConf, new[] { "Go:4", "K", "K", "Go:1", "U" }));
Dojo.Eq("copy a line and paste it twice", new List<string> { "a", "b", "a", "a", "c" }, Session(new List<string> { "a", "b", "c" }, new[] { "M-6", "Down", "U", "U" }));
Dojo.Eq("Go clamps to the last line", new List<string> { "x", "END" }, Session(new List<string> { "x", "y" }, new[] { "Go:99", "Type:END" }));

steps.title: Replace all, and count
steps.prompt: nano reports `Replaced 3 occurrences` after a replace-all. Write `(List<string> Lines, int Count) ReplaceAll(List<string> lines, string find, string with)` that replaces every non-overlapping occurrence of `find` (case-sensitive, scanning left to right) on every line, and returns the new lines and how many replacements were made. If `find` is empty, change nothing and return 0.
starter: (List<string> Lines, int Count) ReplaceAll(List<string> lines, string find, string with)
solution: (List<string> Lines, int Count) ReplaceAll(List<string> lines, string find, string with)
if (at < 0) { sb.Append(line, i, line.Length - i); break; }
hints: Use `IndexOf(find, start, StringComparison.Ordinal)` in a loop.
After a match, continue searching from `at + find.Length`.
template: var dojoR = ReplaceAll(new List<string> { "level=debug", "# debug only", "debugger=off" }, "debug", "info");
Dojo.Eq("lines replaced", new List<string> { "level=info", "# info only", "infoger=off" }, dojoR.Lines);
Dojo.Eq("empty find changes nothing", 0, ReplaceAll(new List<string> { "abc" }, "", "x").Count);
